title: pose-estimation message
description: Skeletons: named keypoints, the links between them and a box around the confident ones, in the pose's color. Version 1 of the contract in docs/contracts.md.

poses.description: Every pose of the frame: a person's body or a hand.

id.description: The pose's identity; it picks the color and shows in the caption.

label.description: Shown in the caption, 'pose' when absent. A class row in the viewer's settings styles poses by it.

bbox.description: Accepted and not drawn in version 1: the viewer boxes the confident keypoints instead.

confidence.description: Accepted and not drawn in version 1.

name.description: The keypoint's name. Links are drawn between COCO body names (nose to right_ankle) and MediaPipe hand names (wrist to pinky_tip); any other name is drawn as a point.

x.description: Video pixels from the left edge.

y.description: Video pixels from the top edge.

confidence.description: Fades the keypoint and its links; only keypoints above 0.3 count toward the pose's box.
